rows.detail: A PowerShell fresh-live scalar indexed the SHA text at the wrong precedence and returned only the first character.
A separate literal live-line scalar parsed the first tab-delimited field and confirmed exact four-way equality without mutation.
The closeout-generation command wrapper returned no usable output after the build process materialized its files.
A read-only status, literal-path, timestamp, size, and process audit confirmed materialized closeout files and no continuing builder process before a bounded builder recovery.
The first final-test aggregate passed fifteen tests and failed one case-sensitive successor-guard phrase assertion.
The candidate made the Caelen Ash no-precontact guard explicit and the single affected test passed once without replaying the aggregate.
